statement: For every integer N ≥ 1 there exist mutually commuting selfadjoint elements dN,1, . . . , dN,N ∈ D ∩ A′, each of norm at most N, with the following properties. Put CN,j = C∗ (A, dN,1, . . . , dN,j−1), sN = 1 √ N N X j=1 dN,j. For every contraction b ∈ CN,j and τ ∈ Λ, |τ(bdN,j)| ≤ 3 N3 , |τ(b(d2 N,j − 1))| ≤ 3 N2 , τ(d4 N,j) ≤ 3. (11.2) For every fixed t ∈ R, lim N→∞ sup τ∈Λ a∈A, ∥a∥≤1 τ(aeitsN ) − e−t2/2 τ(a) = 0. (11.3)
